name: Dads And Sons
overview: Scripture highlights the sacred responsibility and joy found in the relationship between fathers and sons, emphasizing honoring parents as commanded by God to receive His blessing (Exodus 20:12). Fathers are called to lead their households in serving the Lord faithfully (Joshua 24:15) and to diligently train their children in the way they should go, ensuring lasting godliness (Proverbs 22:6). The Bible also portrays the father’s joy in a wise and righteous child as a reflection of God’s loving discipline and correction (Proverbs 3:11; 23:24), while affirming that children bring glory and crown to their fathers (Proverbs 17:6).
